judgment.summary: Separate jacket panels, asymmetric lapels and zipper, cuffs, snaps, rear yoke, chain, tag, and warm-metal aviator rims turn the black torso shell into a readable biker costume.
judgment.next_highest_impact_gap: Replace the launcher blockout with the Fetch Launcher drum, loaded ball, cage rings, hazard panel, muzzle, underbarrel, charge meter, and emblem language.
